talking_points: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers say the company is creating a culture of fear around flagging risks, and OpenAI is standing its ground.
OpenAI's own investors have apparently had to cut its annualised revenue estimate by $20 billion, just as Nvidia-backed data-centre firm Firmus pulled a $5 billion IPO over 'market volatility'.
Ray Dalio says the AI bubble is 'close' to bursting, even as Manus and Nous Research both raised large funding rounds this week.
